'''Noh Do Young''' ({{Korean|hangul=노도영}}; born January 13, 1963) is a South Korean physicist specializing in [[condensed matter physics]] and [[materials science]] using [[synchrotron]]s and [[Free-electron laser#X-ray laser without mirrors|XFELs]]. He has developed and applied various frontier X-ray diffraction methods to study condensed matter systems, including recent coherent X-ray diffraction imaging technique. His research has utilized a number of synchrotron radiation facilities, such as [[Advanced Photon Source]], [[SPring-8]], [[National Synchrotron Light Source]], PLS, and X-ray free electron lasers, including SCALA and PAL-XFEL.

Most of his career has been at the [[Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology]] (GIST) where he was a physics professor, dean of GIST College, and director of the Center for Advanced X-ray Science and the GIST National Core Research Center. He has also served as member of the Korea Research Council of Fundamental Science Technology before becoming the president of the Korea Synchrotron Radiation User's Association. He is a council member of the Presidential Advisory Council for Science and Technology, and the third president of the [[Institute for Basic Science]].

== Education ==
Noh received a B.S. in Physics from [[Seoul National University]] in 1985. He then went to the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] for his Ph.D. which was completed in 1991 under doctoral adviser Professor [[Robert J. Birgeneau]]. His thesis was a series of X-ray scattering studies concerning the positional and orientational order in two and three dimensional liquid crystal systems.

== Career ==
After graduating, he stayed at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology as a post-doctoral associate through 1992. His next position was as a senior physicist at the [[Exxon|Exxon Research and Engineering Company]] in 1993. Two years later, he returned to his home country and started working at the [[Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology]] as an assistant professor in the Department of Physics and Photon Science & School of Materials Science and Engineering. Over the years, he became a full professor, dean of GIST College, and director of the Graduate Program of Photonic Science & Technology and the Center for Advanced X-ray Science.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://x-ray.gist.ac.kr/prog/gsPerson/x-ray/P/view.do?siteCode=x-ray&mno=sub01_01_01&tmplId=template_a1&personId=P00002934 |title= Professor 노도영 Noh, Do Young |author=<!--Not stated--> |date= |website= X-ray Laboratory for Nanoscale Phenomena |publisher= [[Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology]] |access-date= 18 January 2020 |quote= }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.src-erc.or.kr/sub/index.kin?mode=view&main=3&sub=8&main_no=83&no=51&page=1&ifwhat=&ifvalue= |script-title=ko:극미세 초고속 X-선과학 연구센터: Center for Advanced X-ray Science |author=<!--Not stated--> |date= |website= Science Research Center, Engineering Research Center |publisher= |access-date= 17 January 2020 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> He was also the director of the GIST National Core Research Center (NCRC) <!--극한광응용기술국가핵심연구센터--> from 2008 to 2015.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://hellodd.com/?md=news&mt=view&pid=70384 |title= IBS 신임 원장에 노도영 GIST 교수 선임: IBS "방사광 분야 석학···장기·집단 기초연구 이끌 적임자" |last= 한 |first= 효정 |date= 21 November 2019 |website= Hello DD |publisher= (주)대덕넷 |access-date= 17 January 2020 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.etnews.com/200812170088 |script-title=ko:광주과학기술원, 극한광응용기술 연구센터 개소 |last= 김 |first= 한식 |date= 18 December 2008 |website= Etnews |publisher= Electronic Times Internet |access-date= 17 January 2020 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>

He has served as a member of the Korea Research Council of Fundamental Science Technology.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR20200106035551017 |script-title=ko:노도영 원장 "IBS, 한국 대표 기초연구소 되도록 노력"(종합) |last= 신 |first= 선미 |date= 6 January 2020 |website= [[Yonhap News Agency]] |publisher= |access-date= 17 January 2020 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= https://biz.chosun.com/site/data/html_dir/2019/11/21/2019112102266.html |script-title=ko:과기부, 기초과학연구원장에 노도영 교수 선임 |last= 황 |first= 민규 |date= 21 November 2019 |website=[[ChosunBiz]] |publisher=[[ChosunMedia]] |access-date= 17 January 2020 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> Other positions include serving as the chairman of the Foundation Expert Committee, National Science & Technology Council, president of the Korea Synchrotron Radiation User's Association,<ref>{{cite web |url= http://scimonitors.com/%EA%B8%B0%EC%B4%88%EA%B3%BC%ED%95%99%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC%EC%9B%90-%EC%8B%A0%EC%9E%84-%EC%9B%90%EC%9E%A5%EC%97%90-%EB%85%B8%EB%8F%84%EC%98%81-gist-%EA%B5%90%EC%88%98-%EC%9E%84%EB%AA%85/ |script-title=ko:기초과학연구원 신임 원장에 노도영 GIST 교수 임명 |last= 최 |first= 정재 |date= 21 November 2019 |website= The Science Monitor |publisher= |access-date= 17 January 2020 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> and council member on the Presidential Advisory Council for Science and Technology.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.pacst.go.kr/jsp/m/info/councilMember.jsp?pre_cd=MOON02 |script-title= ko:심의위원: 국가과학기술 자문회의 부의장 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date=  |website= Presidential Advisory Council on Science & Technology |publisher=  |access-date= 17 January 2020 |quote=  |language= Korean |archive-date= 4 March 2021 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20210304133421/https://www.pacst.go.kr/jsp/m/info/councilMember.jsp?pre_cd=MOON02 |url-status= dead }}</ref> In November 2019, he became the third president of the [[Institute for Basic Science]] (IBS). His inauguration ceremony was also the farewell ceremony for [[Kim Doochul]], the second IBS president.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.edaily.co.kr/news/read?newsId=03667046622689328 |title= 노도영 IBS 원장 "세계 초일류 기초과학연구소로 성장하겠다" |last= 이 |first= 연호 |date= 25 November 2019 |website= 이데일리 edaily |publisher= |access-date= 10 March 2020 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.joongdo.co.kr/main/view.php?key=20191125010010551 |title= IBS 노도영 신임 원장 취임 "국가 기초과학 연구소로 뿌리 내릴 것" |last= 임 |first= 효인 |date= 25 November 2019 |website= 중도일보 |publisher= |access-date= 10 March 2020 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.atnnews.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=35807 |title= IBS 노도영 신임 원장, "기관 성패, 새로운 발견에 있다" |last= 이 |first= 기종 |date=25 November 2019  |website= ATN News |publisher= |access-date= 10 March 2020 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= http://scimonitors.com/%EA%B8%B0%EC%B4%88%EA%B3%BC%ED%95%99%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC%EC%9B%90-%EC%9B%90%EC%9E%A5-%EC%9D%B4%E2%80%A7%EC%B7%A8%EC%9E%84%EC%8B%9D-%EA%B0%9C%EC%B5%9C/ |script-title=ko:기초과학연구원 원장 이‧취임식 개최 |last= 김 |first= 병석 |date=25 November 2019  |website= The Science Monitor  |publisher= |access-date= 10 March 2020 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>
